caveats: Baseline years 1992-2002 per spec; window dates outside the baseline (1991-12-27..31, 2003-01-01..05) were included as the +/-5-day windows require. Region grid cells are the 60x60 cells with lat in [61.57, 62.77] and lon in [20.17, 21.37] (60 unique lat/lon values in bounds); 3308 of 3600 cells are sea cells (finite SST on every target day), the other 292 are all-NaN land and are 0 in the mask. 'baseline_analysed' reports the extended window dates actually used; the baseline years themselves are 1992-2002.
